Axolotl Squishy


Cute axolotl character made from soft, slow-rise foam for satisfying squeezes 🦎


Super squishy texture helps relieve stress, tension, and restless energy


Compact size fits perfectly in one hand for on-the-go play, fidgeting, or desk breaks


Encourages calm, mindful squeezing—supportive for children with anxiety or sensory needs


Durable, easy-to-clean design ensures long-lasting use at home, school, or in the office


A fun and quirky gift idea for animal lovers, fidget fans, or collectors of kawaii-style toys 💦


Recommended for ages 3 and up; safe and engaging for both kids and adults


Adorably weird and irresistibly squishy, the Axolotl Squishy is a cheerful stress reliever and sensory companion. Whether it’s for calming busy hands, sparking play, or simply bringing a smile, this quirky creature makes every squeeze a moment of joy.
